note: Crafts of the Umbral Depths/Radiant Wastes Reach (dark_light axis). Umbracraft is the dark-pole tradition (the arts of the hidden, sight-without-light, what the light would destroy); Radiance the light-pole (revelation, the beam, the burning truth). Learned by traveling the Reach or training with Umbrals/Blazeborn. Radiant Plateau is a Valley-edge foothill of the light end; Prism Sight is folk-Radiance. Both drift the wielder toward their pole. Note: dark_light here is the MORAL/KNOWING sense as much as the literal — dark = concealed/harbored, light = revealed/exposed — which is why they can partly co-fire (a place both revealing and concealing). axes signed for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016.

abilities.name: Umbracraft
abilities.narrationHints: The dark that hides and the dark that harbors — sight without light, the unseen made ally, the sheltering of what the blaze would burn.
abilities.description: See truly in lightlessness, wrap yourself and a small space in concealment, and use the shadows any place already holds. The dark-pole mastery — not evil, the necessary shadow.
abilities.notFor: Harming from the dark for its own sake (that's a corruption Umbrals themselves fear); revealing (that's Radiance); places with no shadow to work.

tree.name: Harbor

tree.cannot: Harboring something makes you responsible for it; some things should not be harbored, and the Harbor doesn't judge — you must.

tree.name: Deep Umbral
tree.grants: Command shadow at scale — hide a caravan, a rite, a rebellion; see into the hidden hearts of things and places; give sanctuary the Blaze cannot breach. The Underlight's power in miniature.
tree.cannot: The wielder drifts dark-hot — and the one who harbors everything eventually harbors the things that should have faced the light; darkness total is its own foreclosure, a world that never has to be seen.

tree.cannot: The wielder drifts light-hot — and total revelation burns its own land to glass; the one who reveals everything leaves nothing sheltered enough to live; light absolute is foreclosure by exposure, a world with no shadow left to grow in.

IT IS SLOW; A HEALER WHO REACHES THEM IN TIME UNDOES IT
nothing about it looks like violence, and THAT IS WHAT PEOPLE REMEMBER ABOUT YOU

abilities.plainly: A stealth attack that only works on a target unaware of you. It deals 3d6 shadow damage spread over several minutes rather than instantly, so the target has time to be found and helped. At rank 2 they also cannot call out or be heard. Any healer who reaches them before it finishes undoes it completely. A braced or warned target simply notices you and it fails.
abilities._notForWas: Anything that does not breathe. A braced target who knows you are there — this needs them unaware, which is why it is a back-line craft and not a duelling one. And it is SLOW: they have time to be found.

abilities.name: Unlit Step
abilities.narrationHints: They step off the roof and do not fall so much as decline to arrive.
abilities.description: ⚠️ UMBRAL FLIGHT, AND IT IS FALLING SLOWLY IN THE DARK. Not lift — a refusal of the ground's claim, which works only where there is shadow to refuse it in. Silent, unseen, and it goes DOWN and ACROSS far better than it goes up.
abilities.notFor: ⚠️ CLIMBING. It descends and glides; it does not rise. Open daylight and lit ground close it entirely.

tree.name: Unlit Step
tree.grants: Descend and glide through shadow, silently, at speed. Down and across, never up.
tree.cannot: Rising. Lit ground and open daylight.

tree.name: Long Fall
tree.grants: Cross whole valleys by it at night, unseen — the only travel in the game that no one observes.
tree.cannot: Doing it by day, or arriving anywhere lit without being seen the moment you land.

mechanic.note: ⚠️ THE ONLY UNOBSERVED TRAVEL. Legs cost normal days but generate NO road encounters and no arrival notice — the exact inverse of the seraphic version.

intensity.conserve: one silent descent
intensity.surge: cross a valley by night; YOU STILL HAVE TO GET UP THERE FIRST

bounds.text: IT DOES NOT RISE — down and across only, and you must climb before you can use it
LIT GROUND AND OPEN DAYLIGHT CLOSE IT ENTIRELY
nobody sees you go, WHICH MEANS NOBODY KNOWS YOU CAME EITHER

abilities.plainly: A travel, stealth and chase action. You descend and glide through shadow, silently and fast — down and across only, never up, so you have to climb before you can use it, and lit ground or open daylight close it completely. At rank 2 you can cross whole valleys by night unseen. It is the only travel in the game that generates no road encounters and no arrival notice, which cuts both ways: nobody sees you go, so nobody knows you came either.

abilities.name: Carried Dark
abilities.narrationHints: You bring the dark with you rather than finding it. A pocket of unlight that travels at your pace, and inside it you are simply not available to be seen.
abilities.description: Draw dark around yourself and move inside it — sight slides off you, and you can cross a lit room slowly or a dim one at pace. The Umbrals' first craft: not hiding IN shadow, carrying one.
abilities.notFor: Silence (dark does not muffle; a noisy Umbral is a found Umbral); concealing from touch, scent, or a beast that hunts by either; anything in full direct sun.

tree.name: Pocket of Unlight
tree.grants: Draw dark around yourself and move in it. Sight slides off you. You can cross a lit room slowly, or a dim one at pace.
tree.cannot: IT IS ONLY SIGHT. You make the same noise, leave the same tracks, smell the same. Direct strong sun thins it to nothing. And moving fast tears it.

tree.name: Shared Dark
tree.grants: Extend it to others moving with you, or hold it while doing something with your hands.
tree.cannot: Everyone inside must move as you move; one person hurrying breaks it for all of them. Umbrals practise this together for months.

tree.name: Travelling Night
tree.grants: A moving dark large enough for a column, or deep enough that even a Radiant's kindled light does not reach into it.
tree.cannot: ⚠ YOU ARE ALSO INSIDE IT, and Umbral sight is not universal — the people you are carrying are blind. A travelling night full of people who cannot see is its own emergency.

intensity.conserve: a hand's dark — cross one space
intensity.surge: the travelling night; THE PEOPLE YOU ARE CARRYING ARE BLIND

bounds.text: IT IS ONLY SIGHT — sound, tracks and scent are unchanged
direct strong sun thins it to nothing
moving fast TEARS it

abilities.plainly: A puzzle/social action that carries a pocket of unlight with you. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about four hours.
abilities._descriptionWas: The Umbrals' first craft. Not hiding IN shadow — carrying one.

abilities.name: Felt Room
abilities.narrationHints: In the lightless deeps you learn a place by everything except seeing — air movement, the way sound returns, the temperature of stone, the tiny wrongness of a room that has someone standing in it.
abilities.description: Know a lightless space entire — its shape, its exits, its drop-offs, and whether something living is in it and roughly where. The Umbrals' seeing-craft, which is not seeing, and which works best where every other perception craft fails.
abilities.notFor: Colour, writing, faces, or anything that requires light to mean something; working in loud places; reading intent.

tree.name: Read Dark
tree.grants: Know a lightless space entire — its shape, its exits, its drop-offs, and whether something living is in it and roughly where. Better in the dark than most people manage lit.
tree.cannot: ⚠ IT IS WORSE IN LIGHT, not better — a lit room is full of noise for this craft. It cannot read colour, writing, or a face. Loud places flood it.

tree.name: Held Sense
tree.grants: Keep it up while moving, or read a whole complex — passages, water, the wrongness of a collapsed section before you reach it.
tree.cannot: Sustained, it crowds out ordinary attention; Umbrals doing this walk into things that are obvious to everyone else.

tree.name: Whole Deep
tree.grants: An entire underplace known at once, and the things moving in it known as they move.
tree.cannot: ⚠ YOU WILL FEEL THINGS DOWN THERE YOU CANNOT IDENTIFY, and the craft gives you their position and nothing else. The Unlit stopped coming up after doing this too often.

intensity.conserve: read the near dark
intensity.surge: the whole deep; YOU WILL FEEL THINGS YOU CANNOT IDENTIFY

bounds.text: WORSE IN LIGHT — a lit room is noise to it
no colour, no writing, no faces
loud places flood it

abilities.plainly: A puzzle action that reads a lightless place by everything except sight. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 3 for about three hours.
abilities._descriptionWas: The Umbrals' seeing-craft, which is not seeing. It works best exactly where every other perception craft fails.
abilities._perceiveReview: ⛔ SNG-455: perceive tag reviewed per rank. Kept where the player receives information they act on; stripped where the perceiving is the ability's internal mechanism.
abilities._senseNote:
⛔ SNG-470: USABLE IN THE SENSE SLOT. ⛔ DARK'S SENSE — knows a lightless space and what lives in it
⚠️ Erik: 'you're not quite right about the sense abilities — they're probably listed as REVEAL. Check again.' ⛔ HE WAS RIGHT: 56 crafts carry reveal/foresee/track and EVERY tradition has one. My 'only 3 sense crafts' was counting the tag I had hand-applied, not the corpus. ⚠️ THE FILTER IS WHETHER IT READS A LIVE OPPONENT IN THE MOMENT — terrain, objects, history and the dead do not qualify.

abilities.name: Kept Fire
abilities.narrationHints: Fire that stays where you put it and does what you said. Not conjured — kept: it burns on less, in wet, in wind, and it does not spread past the line you drew.
abilities.description: The Blazeborn's first craft, and the unromantic one. Anyone can start a fire; keeping one is the trade.
abilities.notFor: Fire from nothing (a source must exist, however small); burning what will not burn; making it hotter — this is CONTROL, not power; keeping a fire you cannot see.

tree.name: Fire Held
tree.grants: Take an existing flame — a coal, a spark, a lamp — and it burns on almost nothing, through rain and wind, for hours, and it DOES NOT SPREAD past a line you name aloud when you set it.
tree.cannot: A SOURCE MUST EXIST. It does not burn hotter and it will not take hold on what genuinely will not burn. Lose sight of it for long and it becomes an ordinary fire again, with ordinary appetites.

tree.name: Several Fires
tree.grants: A camp's worth, a forge, a signal-chain along a ridge, a controlled burn with an edge you drew — all held at once, all obedient to their lines.
tree.cannot: Each one is attention, and a Blazeborn holding six fires is doing nothing else. A line you drew badly is a line the fire will honour exactly.

tree.name: Long Burning
tree.grants: A fire kept for days — a beacon through a siege, a forge through a working, a burn that clears exactly what you meant and stops at the boundary.
tree.cannot: ⚠ WHEN YOU LET GO IT IS JUST FIRE, in whatever state you left it, and it has been building for days. Blazeborn are taught to put a long burning DOWN, not to walk away from one.

intensity.conserve: hold one small flame
intensity.surge: the long burning; WHEN YOU LET GO IT IS JUST FIRE, and it has been building for days

bounds.text: A SOURCE MUST EXIST — it is control, not creation
it does NOT burn hotter
it honours the line you drew EXACTLY, including a bad one

abilities.plainly: A puzzle/social action that keeps a fire burning where you put it and nowhere else. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 2 for about a day.

abilities.name: Read Burn
abilities.narrationHints: You look at heat and it tells you. What burned here, how hot, how long ago, and — looking forward — where this fire goes next and how fast.
abilities.description: The Blazeborn's seeing-craft. Half of fire-work is knowing what a fire is about to do.
abilities.notFor: Reading anything cold or long-cold (days, not seasons); who set it or why; anything that did not involve heat.

tree.name: Heat Read
tree.grants: Read a burned place or a live fire and the craft NAMES it: what it started in, roughly how hot, how long ago it began — or, on a live one, where it goes next, how fast, and which way is survivable.
tree.cannot: HEAT ONLY, and recent — a season-old burn is cold and silent. It says nothing about who or why. On a live fire it reads the NEXT few minutes, not the hour.

tree.name: Whole Burn
tree.grants: A fire's entire behaviour across a site, or a burned building read room by room — origin, path, and the spots that were fed on purpose.
tree.cannot: Reading a live fire at this depth means being close to it for longer than is sensible.

tree.name: Fire's Whole Course
tree.grants: A wildfire, a burning quarter, a forge-city — where it goes over hours, what it takes, and the one line that holds it.
tree.cannot: ⚠ KNOWING THE LINE IS NOT HOLDING IT, and you will very often be the person who knows exactly which village is not savable.

intensity.conserve: read the near heat
intensity.surge: the whole course; YOU WILL KNOW EXACTLY WHICH VILLAGE IS NOT SAVABLE

bounds.text: HEAT ONLY, and recent — a season-old burn is silent
nothing about who set it or why
on a live fire it reads MINUTES, not hours

abilities.plainly: A puzzle/fight action that reads what burned here and where a live fire goes next. Rated 5 of 10 across a scope of 3 for about two hours.

_wordingFix: ⛔ SNG-436: descriptions rewritten so the FIRST CLAUSE NAMES AN ACTION AND ITS OUTCOME. Erik: 'some of the skills read like they don't do ANYTHING.' 87 of 376 opened by defining the craft — 'The mind-pole mastery:', 'The Masons' holding-craft.' — which places the skill in the tradition's taxonomy, a librarian's job rather than the player's question. ⚠️ THE ACTION WAS ALREADY AUTHORED in `narrationHints` and `tree[0].grants`; this promotes it and keeps the taxonomy line AFTER. Prior text preserved in `_descriptionWas`.
_senseCull: ⛔ SNG-454: perceive-only 'first gift' senses removed — replaced by the single `Attunement` ability whose sectFlavour carries what you perceive.
_namingSOP: ⛔ SNG-461 / SYSTEM_SPEC §31: article removed from craft and rank names except where it names a singular known thing or is the joke.
_gainAxes: ⛔ SNG-468: `gainAxes` derived per rank from the rank's own text. ⚠️ MY MATRIX HAD BEEN READING UNPOPULATED RANKS AS 'ADDS NOTHING' — Erik caught it on Borrowed Form, whose ranks are an hour / a day plus a passenger / the whole party. THE SKILL WAS FINE; THE INSTRUMENT WAS BROKEN.
